geometry: Natural Earth 1:110m admin-0 countries (public domain), via the world-atlas package, in data/map/world-110m.json. Borders are modern; the merges below rebuild the larger 1949 states.
mergeNote: 1949 states that later split up. Known gaps: Germany is not yet divided on the map, Eritrea is shown apart from Ethiopia and Israel's 1949 armistice lines are not drawn.

west.label: Western bloc
west.note: The twelve founding members of the North Atlantic Treaty (signed 4 April 1949), with Greenland as part of Denmark.

allied.label: US-aligned
allied.note: Greece and Turkey under the Truman Doctrine (1947); Japan and South Korea under US occupation or protection; the Philippines, Australia and New Zealand as close Pacific partners.

east.label: Soviet bloc
east.note: Communist-led states in Moscow's orbit by early 1949. Yugoslavia was expelled from the Cominform in June 1948 and is shown unaligned.

contested.label: Contested
contested.note: Civil war in China; Germany and Austria under four-power occupation; war in French Indochina; the Indonesian war of independence against the Netherlands.

blocsNote: Every country not listed is shown unaligned. European colonies in Africa and Asia are shown unaligned too; empires arrive with the diplomacy system. Latin America is left unaligned although most of it signed the Rio Treaty with the US in 1947.

hotspots.label: Berlin airlift
hotspots.note: The blockade began on 24 June 1948 and was lifted on 12 May 1949.

hotspots.label: Greek civil war
hotspots.note: The Democratic Army's last strongholds fell in August 1949; the war ended in October 1949.

hotspots.label: Chinese civil war
hotspots.note: Peiping fell in January 1949 and Nanjing in April. The People's Republic was proclaimed on 1 October and the Nationalists withdrew to Taiwan in December.

hotspots.label: War in Indochina
hotspots.note: Fighting began in December 1946 and ended with the Geneva Accords in July 1954.

hotspots.label: Indonesian revolution
hotspots.note: The Netherlands transferred sovereignty on 27 December 1949.
